page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated physical CPU cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 2 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It also lacks GPU accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or machine learning workloads. Additionally, the instance comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

A key technical characteristic of the ecs.s2.xlarge is the absence of advanced CPU instruction sets. The processor lacks support for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI), and virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM). This hardware profile is designed for basic general-purpose workloads, such as lightweight web serving, simple application hosting, and development environments that do not rely on specialized instruction sets or heavy parallel processing.
